title: 📹 New images show the impact of Iranian strikes on the US base “Al-Adiri”
text:
📹 New images show the impact of Iranian strikes on the US base “Al-Adiri”"

"🔺 New images obtained by CBS News show extensive damage at the base hosting US troops in Kuwait after Iran’s missile and drone attacks."

"🔺 US service members, speaking to CBS on condition of anonymity, described Al-Adiri base as “completely destroyed” and said Iran “hit them hard.”
